response.overview: This 1 hour and 45-minute documentary, focusing exclusively on graffiti in the Madrid metro, is the largest graffiti production ever made in the city.  Packed with action, close calls, impossible access points, adrenaline, tension, and laughter, it is a film  that leaves no one indifferent.  It s a snapshot of an era, a documentary record of our passion that will be remembered for years to come. It's a must-have for any serious writer's collection.  In today's world of 30-second Tiktoks and fleeting Instagram stories, we've chosen to go with something timeless: a physical format that will last a lifetime. With this release, you'll always have a piece of graffiti history at your fingertips to enjoy whenever you want. It's an analog breath of fresh air in a world of digital likes, designed for true collectors.
response.title: Madrid 24/7: Part II
